## Activity

Capture activity at River Outreach during April 2023 totalled 57. The volume recorded for the month provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No operational issue affecting the recorded capture activity was noted in the information provided.

## Image quality

Of the 57 captures, 5 were marked ungradable by graders. This represents an ungradable rate of 8.8. The result identifies the proportion of submitted image sets that could not be assessed and should be considered alongside the grading outcome. The available information does not identify a further cause or pattern for the ungradable captures.

## Grading

A total of 5 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2. This provides the central measure of the time from capture submission to completion of grading for the month. Overall, the reported activity, image-quality findings and grading results reflect the operation of River Outreach during April 2023, with routine leave noted as the only qualification to planned session lists.
